args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The nightly build fails because tests/test_money.py expects banker's
rounding but round_money was quantizing with ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch to
ROUND_HALF_EVEN as specified in FIN-212.

args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix banker's rounding in round_money (FIN-212)
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding, but `round_money` in `src/money.py` was quantizing with `ROUND_HALF_UP`. This PR switches the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` per FIN-212.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: Changed the rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including the updated tests covering `2.675 -> 2.68` and `2.665 -> 2.66`.
